summary: Backend-only regression retest after Tahap 5/6/7 fix in server.latest_updates and synthesize_delta defensive default. 11/11 tests PASS (194s). All four target URLs (kompas B50, IHSG, ANTM, Rupiah) now return has_update=true with non-empty ascending-dated timelines and confidence.reason mentioning domains + korroborasi. The iteration_4 HIGH inconsistency (has_update:false + non-empty timeline) is FIXED. Consistency invariant test added and passing across all URLs. Seeded-overlay test also passes: even when timeline_store is seeded with 3 synthetic post-baseline events, /api/latest-updates returns has_update=true, populated overview, and the 3 seed dates appear in the merged returned timeline.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Tahap 6 reorders compute_confidence to AFTER merge_timeline — correct fix. Confidence.reason now reflects merged timeline, not fresh-only delta.
server.py Tahap 7 fallback (has_update forced true + overview populated + confidence.reason appended when merged has post-baseline events) — implemented and verified end-to-end via seed test.
services.py synthesize_delta defensive default now `bool(developments) or bool(timeline)` — good.
services.py CacheAndRateLimit.set_cached_delta now uses upsert=True — good; empty-cache TTL test still passes.
Minor: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown — non-blocking, but consider FastAPI lifespan handlers for future upgrades.

Test note: monkeypatching srv.synthesize_delta from pytest doesn't affect the running uvicorn process; test relies on the merge-overlay invariant instead, which still exercises the fallback path when the fresh LLM delta happens to be empty. Documented in test docstring.
test_credentials: none required — public endpoints; EMERGENT_LLM_KEY + TAVILY_API_KEY loaded from /app/backend/.env
seed_data_creation: test_forced_accumulated_overlay_via_seed writes 3 synthetic post-baseline events into db.timeline_store for the kompas B50 URL hash, then restores the previous document (or deletes) in a finally block. test_empty_cache_ttl_behavior seeds+cleans a TEST_EMPTY_TTL_HASH_* doc in summary_cache.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_4 HIGH regression is closed. Full suite green in 194s. If timeline_store accumulates stale synthetic seed rows, cleanup happens automatically in the finally block, but manual purge is `db.timeline_store.deleteMany({timeline: {$elemMatch: {event: /^SEED_/}}})`.

rca of the issue.bug: iteration_4 — /api/latest-updates could return has_update:false while timeline contained post-baseline dated events (self-contradictory response).
rca of the issue.root_cause: compute_confidence ran BEFORE merge_timeline; and synthesize_delta defensive default derived has_update only from developments, ignoring timeline.
rca of the issue.mitigation: server.latest_updates now (a) merges timeline first, (b) computes confidence on the merged timeline, (c) forces has_update=true + populates overview + appends 'peristiwa akumulatif pasca-baseline' to confidence.reason when merged has post-baseline events but fresh delta was empty. services.synthesize_delta default now uses `bool(developments) or bool(timeline)`.
rca of the issue.verification: 11/11 pytest cases pass including the newly-added invariant test and the seeded-overlay test.
